changeSet.author: Bhoward
changeSet.sql: IF (NOT EXISTS(SELECT Top 1 [FieldName] FROM [dbo].[Setting] WHERE [FieldName] = 'MaxExcelExportRows')) BEGIN Insert INTO Setting (FieldName,Name,Description,DefaultValue) VALUES('MaxExcelExportRows','Maximum Excel Export Rows', 'This is the maximum number of items able to be exported in an excel spreadsheet.',10000) END
changeSet.rollback: IF (EXISTS(SELECT Top 1 [FieldName] FROM [dbo].[Setting] WHERE [FieldName] = 'MaxExcelExportRows')) BEGIN DELETE FROM Setting WHERE [FieldName] = 'MaxExcelExportRows' END
